title: The Architecture of the Cosmos: Model-Independent Constraints on the Hubble Constant and Dark Energy Equation of State from DESI DR2 BAO, Pantheon+ Supernovae, and JWST Distance-Ladder Calibrations
description: A 48-page comprehensive research monograph and numerical synthesis analyzing the Hubble tension (H0) and dynamical dark energy equation of state w(z) across DESI DR2 Baryon Acoustic Oscillations, Pantheon+/Union3/DES-Y5 Type Ia Supernovae, Cosmic Chronometers, Planck CMB shift parameters, JWST TRGB/JAGB/Cepheid local distance-ladder calibrations, TDCOSMO XXVII JWST strong lensing time delays, and neutrino mass sum bounds.
